_comment: Designated GPU sweep pointer for the ml-sweep-loop cycle.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: `gh variable set SWEEP_WANDB_SWEEP_ID` returns HTTP 403
for the GITHUB_TOKEN of these workflows ('Resource not accessible by
integration' - the job token has no actions:variables grant). Every sweep
id minted since 2026-08-14 therefore became unreachable: a kernel push
always joined whatever stale id the repo variable still held.
`.github/` is the only tree that is BOTH public and served verbatim to the
runner (the 'Pull private tree' step overlays everything EXCEPT .git and
.github). So this file is the writable pointer channel that needs no PAT,
no admin and no variables scope.
PRECEDENCE (see the 'Resolve designated sweep' step in both
2. repo variable SWEEP_WANDB_SWEEP_ID (if this file is absent)
The ml-sweep-loop skill's hard rule is preserved: WANDB_SWEEP_ID (the
shared TPU-agent variable) stays unset and is never created here.
supersedes: m3gdk0yc-adjacent orphans: 8p4t1juu, xqlix7jx, kzv86bvy, l6j9d86b, z86wszrq, 54pkjxrp (all 0 runs)

notes: Adopted, not re-minted. m3gdk0yc already exists on the server (PENDING, 0 runs), is cap-clean by construction, replicates n=3, and carries the two corrections with the best GPU-side evidence (lr floor 0.00136-0.00139, clw centred high at {null,64,128,256}). Re-minting a successor would only add a seventh orphan while the blocker is execution and pointer plumbing, not search design.
